<!-- For a rule change: which specification section or tool behaviour is it based on? -->

- [ ] `npm test` passes (every rule's examples are tests)
- [ ] `npm run docs` was run if a rule changed
- [ ] `npm run conformance` passes: every disagreement with a corpus is explained in `conformance/<format>.ts`
- [ ] New or changed levels follow "default = what breaks tools, strict = the letter of the specification"
